title: Governed record-linkage project tour
description: Inspect both synthetic sources, run quality checks, review explainable threshold classifications, exchange a fingerprint-bound review artifact, and build a conflict-aware person-cluster proposal without merging records.
prerequisite: Import the Synthetic Patient Record Linkage example project. It includes two source tables, five known truth links, and a saved command tour.

steps.title: Confirm the governed boundary
steps.instruction: The project contains two fictional eight-record sources and a five-link truth table. No comparison, threshold classification, or merge runs automatically when the project opens.

steps.title: Open the saved linkage workflow
steps.instruction: Select Open Pgm. The complete workflow is stored with the project.

steps.title: Load visible linkage source
steps.instruction: Choose recordlink-command-tour and select Open. Loading the program does not execute it.

steps.title: Verify the workflow
steps.instruction: Select Verify Program. Review the QUALITY, LIST, FREQ, TABLES, and governed EPIAI RECORDLINK commands before execution.

steps.title: Run reviewed comparisons
steps.instruction: Select Run Commands. The workflow blocks candidates, calculates deterministic exact and fuzzy scores, and applies the visible review/match thresholds. Nothing mutates either source.

steps.title: Review candidate scores and classes
steps.instruction: Inspect blocking counts, score distribution, threshold classes, truth-set precision/recall/F1, and field-level contributions. Candidate identifiers and patient values remain out of Output and history.

steps.title: Inspect the review-queue pair
steps.instruction: Choose Review pair for Candidate 5. Identifiers, original values, and normalized values appear only in the transient local dialog. Compare the one-day date variation and choose a decision plus a controlled reason.

steps.title: Record an explicit decision
steps.instruction: Choose Match, Non-match, or Uncertain and a controlled reason, then select Save decision. This creates an in-memory audit event; it does not create a link, cluster people, run MERGE, or change source data.

steps.title: Export governed review evidence
steps.instruction: Select Export review artifact. The JSON contains candidate ordinals, decisions, versions, the canonical plan, and a candidate-set fingerprint. It contains no patient identifiers or field values and can be replayed only against the identical project result.

steps.title: Build the reviewed cluster proposal
steps.instruction: After every review candidate has a conclusive Match or Non-match decision, select Build person clusters. The deterministic proposal permits at most one record from each source per person and reports competing edges without changing source data.

steps.title: Inspect the audit history
steps.instruction: Open History to confirm the source, plan version, status, and aggregate result summary.
